description: Platform & infrastructure — the remaining Phase 13 gaps: analytical indexing, graph-traversal workers, server-side tiling, faceted search, collections & annotations, map export, full keyboard/mobile a11y, PWA/offline, and i18n. Excludes already-done deck.gl rendering, distance-matrix workers, NL search, autocomplete, embed, shareable URLs, dark mode, reduced motion.

userStories.title: DuckDB analytical index over the TSVs
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a runtime analytical index so heavy tabular/faceted queries are fast, complementing the Neo4j graph store.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a runtime DuckDB (or SQLite) index built over lexicons/*.tsv at startup for complex tabular/aggregate queries; TSV remains the source of truth
Route heavy tabular queries (faceting, aggregates) through the index; graph/correlation queries continue to use Neo4j (tasklist 16)
Index rebuilds are incremental and documented; no change to the TSV write path
vitest tests cover query parity between index and in-memory results; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Graph-traversal WebWorker task
userStories.description: As a developer, I want graph traversal off the main thread so large neighborhood/path queries stay responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a graph/BFS/DFS task variant to the ComputationTask union (shared/computation.ts) and the worker (client/src/workers/computation.worker.ts)
Expose it via the existing use-computation-worker hook
Pure traversal logic lives in shared/computation.ts and is unit-tested
vitest tests cover traversal correctness; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Server-side viewport/bbox map API
userStories.description: As a user, I want the map to load only what's in view so large datasets stay fast end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Add bbox/zoom query params to the map data endpoints so the server returns only features intersecting the viewport
Wire the client viewport culling (client/src/lib/visualization/map-performance.ts) to request tiles/bbox from the server
Responses are bounded and paginated; whole-FeatureCollection responses are no longer required for large layers
vitest tests cover bbox filtering; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Progressive summary/detail loading
userStories.description: As a user, I want summaries first and details on demand so initial load is fast.
acceptanceCriteria: Add summary endpoints returning lightweight records, with detail-on-demand endpoints for full entity data
Client fetches summaries first and hydrates detail lazily (React Query), with skeleton states
Documented summary/detail contract per domain
vitest tests cover the summary vs detail shapes; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Faceted global search
userStories.description: As a user, I want faceted search results so I can filter by domain and attributes.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend server/services/global-search.ts SearchResponse with facet counts (per entity type and key attributes) and filter-by-facet params
Update client/src/components/global-search-dialog.tsx to render facet counts and apply facet filters
Faceting works with the DuckDB index (US-001) where beneficial
vitest tests cover facet counts + filtering; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Generalized related-entities suggestions
userStories.description: As a user, I want 'related entities' on every detail panel so I can explore connections everywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Generalize the RelatedEntity pattern (currently in CultureDataCard.tsx) to a shared component/hook usable by all detail panels
Related entities are sourced from the shared graph (tasklist 16) and/or cross-domain proximity, with provenance
Wire it into language, civilization, battle, religion, and other detail panels
vitest tests cover the shared related-entities component; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Collaborative collections
userStories.description: As a user, I want to curate collections of entities so I can group them around a theme and share them.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a collections API (create/list/get/update/delete) and persistence (TSV or index) with ownership
Add a collections UI to add/remove entities and view a collection; collections are shareable via URL
Collections reference entities by stable id (tasklist 18 US-009)
vitest tests cover collection CRUD; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: User annotations & notes on entities
userStories.description: As a user, I want to attach notes/annotations to entities so I can record my own observations.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an annotations API and persistence keyed by entity id + user
Add annotation UI on detail panels (create/edit/delete), clearly separated from authoritative data
Annotations are private by default with an option to share
vitest tests cover annotation CRUD; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Map/canvas screenshot export
userStories.description: As a user, I want to export the current map view as an image so I can use it in presentations.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend client/src/lib/visualization/export-utils.ts to capture Leaflet/deck.gl map views (canvas/dom capture), not just SVG viz
Exported images include the existing attribution watermark
Support PNG at high resolution
vitest tests cover the export path with a mocked canvas; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Full keyboard navigation & touch/gesture a11y
userStories.description: As a keyboard or touch user, I want to navigate map entities and all viz modes so the app is fully accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: Add arrow-key traversal across interactive map features (building on useMapAccessibility.ts) with focus indicators and SR announcements
Add explicit touch/gesture handling and complete the responsive layout audit across all visualization modes (use-mobile hook applied systematically)
Keyboard shortcuts documented and discoverable
vitest tests cover keyboard traversal logic; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: PWA & offline support
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want an installable, offline-capable app so I can use cached data without a connection.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a web app manifest and a service worker (e.g. vite-plugin-pwa/workbox) caching the app shell and selected datasets
The app is installable and serves cached data offline with a clear offline indicator
Cache invalidation strategy documented
vitest/build checks cover manifest + SW registration; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Internationalization (i18n, RTL, calendars, native scripts)
userStories.description: As a non-English user, I want a localized UI so the app is usable in my language and script.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an i18n framework (react-i18next or similar) and externalize UI strings, starting with a scaffold + one non-English locale
Add app-wide RTL layout support (not just script-sample dir attributes) for Arabic/Hebrew/Farsi
Add localized date/calendar formatting via Intl (Islamic/Chinese calendars) alongside BCE/CE
Display entity names in native scripts + romanization consistently across domains
vitest tests cover locale switching + RTL + calendar formatting; `npm run check` passes
